## Claude Code Instructions

This project uses **bd (beads)** for issue tracking.
Run `bd prime` for workflow context.

**Quick reference:**
- `bd ready` - Find unblocked work
- `bd create "Title" --type task --priority 2` - Create issue
- `bd close <id>` - Complete work
- `bd dolt push` - Push changes to remote (run at session end)

If you previously referenced another assistant in documentation or automation, update those references to Claude Code and verify any integration details specific to Claude Code in your CI or editor configuration.
